newsitem.title: RUSSIA: KLM adds direct Amsterdam-St Petersburg route.
newsitem.headline: KLM adds direct Amsterdam-St Petersburg route.

text.p: The Netherlands's KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV air carrier will begin direct regular passenger flights between Amsterdam and St Petersburg, Russia, from March 31, a KLM representative said on Friday.
Irina Rumyantseva told Reuters that KLM would operate a Boeing 737 for flights on Mondays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays.
She said KLM now flies to St Petersburg via Helsinki. These flights would not be affected.
A KLM statement said the company now has 10 flights a week between Amsterdam and Moscow and seven weekly flights between Amsterdam and St Petersburg.
